name: wl93e_nearmirror_reference_v1
classification: WL93D-dependent visual reference follow-up; suffix WL93E; no architecture hypothesis
scene: scene.json (CK2 geometry, light, 3x3 patch checker, camera retained; resolution increased)

conditions.S1: bit-identical WL86 frozen ER state, all seven anisotropic GGX lobes and refracted inner terms preserved; not a single-alpha material
conditions.G075: single isotropic GGX, alpha=0.075, F0=1, weight=0.85
conditions.MIRROR: true delta reflection, reflectance=0.85; not alpha=0 in a finite GGX evaluation

roughness_convention: au/av are direct GGX slope parameters, no squaring or perceptual remap; sqrt(alpha) is only a labelled r^2-convention equivalent
scope: Physical path tracing under specified passive analytic GGX/delta materials and frozen ER elsewhere; S1 reference is REF-ER, not the original layered-BSDF P reference. M64 is never ground truth.
controls: Only panel material changes across conditions. Same geometry, lights, camera, patch texture, depth, pixel filter, exposure and tone mapping. G075/G040/G010/MIRROR also share neutral reflectance and differ only in roughness/delta limit. S1 differs in spectral weight and lobe composition and is a historical control.

texture_variants.none: existing uniform 0.5 counterpart; paired common random numbers

render.filter: box pixel integral by uniform subpixel jitter

preview.selection: physical references only, same scene for every material; never inspect model error to select framing

instrumentation: Run-time copy of the preserved pt86 trace: patch texture lookup inherited from checker93d; explicit mirror delta; first camera vertex panel => reflection contribution equals events 2..6 on panel pixels. Events 1,2,3..6 retained independently.
frozen_ecro: Near-mirror/new GGX states are not in the six-state frozen ECRO material contract: no fidelity verdict or model inference there. Optional S1 C0 readout uses original CK2 bx38/none frozen tables unchanged; identical material/camera/geometry to REF-ER, but the checker distribution itself is a post-hoc OOD diagnostic, not an IID qualification.
measurements: centre-ray ROI and mirror-hit patch correspondence
linear-HDR textured/uniform response slope and Pearson correlation vs ideal delta
Michelson contrast of textured/uniform ratios and retention vs ideal
edge-aligned ratio profile and 10-90 percent transition width in native pixels
RMS independent-replica difference / 2 as estimated standard error of the two-replica mean; spatial RMS, not a per-pixel confidence interval
low-order closure against independent direct point-light analytic evaluation on the reflected box face

noise_and_stops.material_tests: parameter and dispatch checks mandatory; stop invalid component or correspondence; physical reference continues if model material unsupported
noise_and_stops.if_noise_fails: report unresolved or append disclosed sampling-only extension before further sampling; do not tune material/scene using model

outputs: evaluation/93E/; raw arrays and execution provenance results/ecro_nearmirror93e/; images at shared exposure and shared component scales, no per-image normalization
prohibited: training, parameter tuning, new architecture, branch/worktree creation, alteration of prior worklogs/checkpoints/references, downstream experiment
